summary: Mobile Infrastructure Corp filed an 8-K (Item 8.01 Other Events) to announce the board-authorized declaration of monthly dividends on its Series A Preferred Stock ($4.791/share) and Series 1 Preferred Stock ($4.583/share), payable June 12, 2026, to holders of record as of May 28 and May 24, 2026, respectively. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change is involved. The filing is a standard current report on dividend payments, with no impact on deal activity or risk arbitrage.
